name: Parley
description: Real-time chat with public rooms, DMs and group chats plus a Gemini co-pilot you can @mention — running entirely on Netlify edge/serverless functions and Blobs.

paragraphs: Real-time chat with public rooms, DMs and group chats, and a Gemini co-pilot you can @mention. Messages, typing indicators, read receipts and reactions reach everyone live, usually in under a second. It runs entirely on Netlify: a streaming edge function for live updates, serverless functions for the API, and Netlify Blobs as the database.
features: Public rooms (#lobby, #ai-ml, #placements, #random), one-to-one DMs and group chats.
Live typing indicators, online presence, unread badges and ✓✓ read receipts in DMs and groups.
Emoji reactions, replies with quotes, editing and deleting your own messages.
Image and file sharing up to 4 MB: attach, paste or drag and drop, with an upload progress bar and a lightbox.
Optimistic sending: your message appears instantly, then reconciles with the server copy.
